title: Righteousness Through Faith in Christ, Straining Toward the Goal

questions.question: Look out for the dogs, look out for the evildoers, look out for those who mutilate the ____.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:2 (ESV): "Look out for the dogs, look out for the evildoers, look out for those who mutilate the flesh."

questions.question: For we are the circumcision, who worship by the Spirit of God and glory in Christ Jesus and put no confidence in the ____.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:3 (ESV): "For we are the circumcision, who worship by the Spirit of God and glory in Christ Jesus and put no confidence in the flesh—"

questions.question: Paul lists his fleshly credentials. He was circumcised on the ____ day.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:5 (ESV): "circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;"

questions.question: Paul says he was of the people of Israel, of the tribe of ____.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:5 (ESV): "circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin,"

questions.question: As to zeal, a persecutor of the church; as to righteousness under the law, ____.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:6 (ESV): "as to zeal, a persecutor of the church; as to righteousness under the law, blameless."

questions.question: But whatever gain I had, I counted as ____ for the sake of Christ.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:7 (ESV): "But whatever gain I had, I counted as loss for the sake of Christ."

questions.question: Indeed, I count everything as loss because of the surpassing worth of ____ Christ Jesus my Lord.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:8 (ESV): "Indeed, I count everything as loss because of the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord."

questions.question: For his sake I have suffered the loss of all things and count them as ____, in order that I may gain Christ.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:8 (ESV): "For his sake I have suffered the loss of all things and count them as rubbish, in order that I may gain Christ"

questions.question: Paul wants to be found in him, not having a righteousness of his own that comes from the law, but that which comes through ____ in Christ.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:9 (ESV): "and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own that comes from the law, but that which comes through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God that depends on faith—"

questions.question: That I may know him and the power of his ____, and may share his sufferings, becoming like him in his death.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:10 (ESV): "that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and may share his sufferings, becoming like him in his death,"

questions.question: Brothers, I do not consider that I have made it my own. But one thing I do: forgetting what lies ____ and straining forward to what lies ____,
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:13 (ESV): "Brothers, I do not consider that I have made it my own. But one thing I do: forgetting what lies behind and straining forward to what lies ahead,"

questions.question: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the upward ____ of God in Christ Jesus.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:14 (ESV): "I press on toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus."

questions.question: For many, of whom I have often told you and now tell you even with tears, walk as ____ of the cross of Christ.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:18 (ESV): "For many, of whom I have often told you and now tell you even with tears, walk as enemies of the cross of Christ."

questions.question: Their end is destruction, their god is their ____, and they glory in their shame, with minds set on earthly things.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:19 (ESV): "Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and they glory in their shame, with minds set on earthly things."

questions.question: But our ____ is in heaven, and from it we await a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.
questions.explanation: Philippians 3:20 (ESV): "But our citizenship is in heaven, and from it we await a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,"

key_verse_text: Brothers, I do not consider that I have made it my own. But one thing I do: forgetting what lies behind and straining forward to what lies ahead, I press on toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus.
